title.zh: 将马斯巴特省 马斯巴特市镇马斯巴特北小学的名称变更为Amancio Aguilar 小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Masbate North Elementary School in the Municipality of Masbate, Province of Masbate, to Amancio Aguilar Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Masbate North Elementary School in the Municipality of Masbate, Province of Masbate, to Amancio Aguilar Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học Masbate North tại Thị trấn Masbate, Tỉnh Masbate thành Trường tiểu học Amancio Aguilar
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Masbate North ในเทศบาล Masbate, จังหวัด Masbate เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Amancio Aguilar
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar Masbate North di Kotamadya Masbate, Provinsi Masbate menjadi Sekolah Dasar Amancio Aguilar
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah Masbate North di Perbandaran Masbate, Wilayah Masbate menjadi Sekolah Rendah Amancio Aguilar

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1968/ra_5395_1968.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Masbate North Elementary School in the Municipality of Masbate, Province of Masbate, is hereby changed to Amancio Aguilar Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 15, 1968.
